_comment: Mission 1, Scene 5: Evening (docs/script/mission1.md). Scripted, movement locked throughout. Wait events stage the beats (cutscenes/m1_evening.json): mateo_enters, to_fridge (the notices come off), to_table (he sits; the notices on the table), envelope_down, tomi_counts / tomi_back (option 2 only), mateo_stands. Only option 2 changes state (tomi_involved +1). No Loyalty, Heat or mission log changes.

evening.text: Evening. A lamp on. Abuela sits at the table with a basket of mending. Tomi is on the couch with his homework open and his shoes off.

comes_in.text: Mateo comes in and shuts the door. He keeps his jacket on.

shop.speaker: TOMI
shop.text: Did you go to the shop? Did Nando show you the balancer?

needle.text: Abuela threads a needle. She doesn't look up.

notices.text: Mateo takes the electric notices off the fridge. He sits at the table and takes a thick envelope out of his jacket. He puts it down next to the notices.

more.speaker: TOMI
more.text: That's more than the restaurant paid in a month.

options.text: It covers the electric. And the one under it.

counts.text: Tomi crosses the room and counts in twos, fast. He doesn't say the number.

hums.text: The lamp hums. Tomi looks from the envelope to Mateo.

mending_down.text: Abuela puts the mending down. She looks at Mateo's hands, then at his jacket.

take_off.speaker: ABUELA
take_off.text: Take that off. Dinner is on the stove.

stays.text: Mateo stands. The envelope stays where it is.

needle_again.text: Abuela picks up the needle again. She doesn't touch the money.
